item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei built or meaningfully expanded a narrow, lawful emergency-powers framework with civilian oversight, complaint handling, or independent review of abuse. The positive evidence is limited to discretionary pardons/commutations and does not show restraint of police, intelligence, or administrative coercion. The strongest available evidence points the other way: expanded surveillance, compulsory veiling enforcement, punitive penalties, and broad security-agency involvement.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-06","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/","summary":"Iran’s authorities used widespread surveillance, mass police checks, car confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, and “morality” classes to enforce veiling rules. This is strong evidence of security-administrative control being used for intimidation and punishment, not narrowly lawful enforcement.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.2","3B.1"]},{"title":"Iran: Two years after ‘Woman Life Freedom’ uprising, impunity for crimes reigns supreme","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-09-11","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/09/iran-two-years-after-woman-life-freedom-uprising-impunity-for-crimes-reigns-supreme/","summary":"Amnesty documented continuing violent enforcement of veiling rules, including lethal force against a woman during a car confiscation effort, and said authorities still had not carried out impartial investigations. This supports a pattern of coercive control and impunity.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.2","3B.4","3B.1"]},{"title":"Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/","summary":"The new veiling law imposed death-penalty exposure, flogging, prison terms, travel bans, and broader enforcement powers for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij units.
